messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Grouped boxplot replacing median and quartiles by mean, sd, min and max
parts:
As far as I can tell, there is no `cast` function in ggplot2 (v0.9.3.1). Perhaps you are looking for the reshape2 package?


On May 9, 2013, at 9:12 AM, Wagner Moreira <wagne...@gmail.com> wrote:

Greetings,

I'm new to the ggplot2 package and I'm trying to build a grouped boxplot replacing the median and quartiles by mean, sd, min and max, using the following code:

Plot.2<-cast( sample_size~.,value="R2",data=logpoigrouped_v2,fun=c( min,max,sd,mean ) )

ggplot( Plot.2, aes( x=factor( sample_size ) ) ) + geom_boxplot( aes( fill=factor ( DIST ), lower=mean-sd, upper=mean+sd, middle=mean, ymin=min, ymax=max), stat="identity" ) + stat_summary( aes( group=DIST ) ) 

However, when I run this, I get the following error: "Error: could not find function "cast"". The library ggplot2 is active.

What might be wrong?
Are there any other way of doing this plot?

See attached an example of how the plot should look like.

Thanks in advance for you attention,

Wagner
